summary: Brady Corp, through subsidiary Brady Worldwide, closed the acquisition of Honeywell International's Productivity Solutions and Services business for $1.4 billion in cash, subject to post-closing adjustments, per an Equity Purchase Agreement dated April 20, 2026. Funding came from cash on hand and credit facility borrowings. The closing on August 3, 2026 triggered transition services and intellectual property license agreements to facilitate separation. No board recommendation or advisors were named. The deal represents a major strategic expansion, and watch for integration risks and any post-closing purchase price adjustments.
